value.name: reads Marcus's name on addendum
value.description: Asha reads Marcus's printed name on the addendum and notices the blank line beneath it.
evidence: rcus's name was printed in the small block beneath hers, the line under it still blank
She read the name the way she would have read a clause in someone else's contract

value.name: sets addendum back carefully
value.description: She places the page back on the same spot and aligns its corner precisely, signaling hesitation and control.
evidence: then set the page back down on the same square of grain it had come from, corner aligned to corner
the small precision of that gesture was the only part of the decision she was willing to make right now

value.name: chooses not to call anyone
value.description: Asha refuses to act immediately, leaving the phone untouched and declining to call Claire or the notary.
evidence: She did not slide it away and she did not pick up the phone
The phone stayed face down where she had left it
She did not reach for Claire's number, and she did not reach for the notary's

value.name: lets forty-eight-hour deadline continue
value.description: Asha recognizes that the forty-eight hours she bought are passing as she delays making a decision.
evidence: the forty-eight hours she had bought herself began, in the quiet, to feel like exactly what they were: time she had agreed to spend looking at this
the forty-eight hours kept running the way she had agreed they would

value.name: rechecks Marcus's name
value.description: Asha lifts the addendum again and rereads Marcus's name, focusing on the blank line beneath it.
evidence: After a minute she lifted the addendum again, not to sign it but to read Marcus's name once more
She held the page level under the kitchen light and let her eyes settle on the blank line beneath his printed name

value.name: maintains decision through repeated hesitation
value.description: She repeats the same careful handling of the page, showing she is still not ready to commit.
evidence: After another minute Asha lifted the addendum a third time
and nudged the corner until it matched the corner beneath it

value.name: touches blank signature line
value.description: Asha places her fingertip on the blank line, stopping just short of signing.
evidence: let her fingertip rest on the blank line be
